title: Grant
description: A scoped, dated, expiring delegation of actions from an operator to a supervisor actor (docs/design/m0/04 "Grants"). A supervisor cannot create, extend or widen grants; confirmation overrides may only tighten. internal/authority enforces both.

reads.description: The read scope [M5]: which projects (same as projects, or listed) and which resource kinds.

confirmation_overrides.description: Per action, a stricter confirmation than its default; never a looser one.

approval.description: The approval that confirmed the grant's proposal, recorded in the same command, whose actor is issued_by; null when an operator issued the grant directly (D31: policy none, whose approvals this build does not persist).

ActionKind.description: A mutating action kind of the action registry (schemas/vocab), e.g. task.create or policy.widen_destinations.

ProjectScope.description: The projects a grant covers: a list, or every project.
